convention: ry = degrees about +Y (three.js rotation.y, counter-clockwise from above) that brings the model FRONT to +Z; walls/gates: length axis Z becomes X. Packs: node pivots are base-centre, no yaw. | packs (S1c): `packs[pack/node]` = {ry, dim 'h'|'w', target_m, k (= target / model size along dim, AFTER ry), size_m}; node pivots are base-centre; apply ry first, then uniform k. Wall-mount lamps: ry puts the lamp side on +Z and the wall plate on -Z.
